Collier & Miller is here to help you source and supply a huge range of specialty and consumer products within the Agricultural, Engineering and industrial sectors. We are currently seeking to hire a qualified and experienced Mechanical Trade (Fitting) to join our manufacturing department in Griffith NSW.  

Mechanical Trade (Fitting) 
At Collier & Miller, a Fitter is an advanced mechanical technician specializing in the installation, 
manufacturing, maintenance, and repair of industrial machinery, parts, and mechanical systems. This 
role requires a high level of technical expertise, advanced problem-solving skills, and a strong 
commitment to safety. 

Core Capabilities: 

Precision Installation and Assembly: 

-  Lead installation and assembly of machinery, including pumps and electric motors, ensuring
precise alignment to engineering standards
-  Utilize advanced fitting techniques, including CNC programming, tool setting, and high precision machinery, to manufacture, shape, align, and assemble parts and subassemblies
with exact tolerances

Expert Maintenance and Repairs:

-  Perform in-depth diagnostics on mechanical systems to identify faults and determine the
best repair methods, ensuring rapid resolution and minimal disruption to operations
-  Repair, test, and reassemble critical equipment, including fluid power systems, to uphold
safety and operational integrity

Technical Interpretation and CNC Programming:

-  Interpret engineering drawings and specifications to guide material selection, machining, and
operations
-  Program CNC machinery and adjust setups to meet detailed technical requirements of each
Project

Machining and Assembly of Metal Parts:

-  Fabricate and install metal parts and subassemblies for machines and equipment, ensuring
proper fit and alignment using high-precision measuring tools and techniques
-  Fit, assemble, and inspect metal components for accuracy, clearance, and precise
functionality within machinery

Hydraulic and Pneumatic System Installation:

-  Cut, thread, bend, and install hydraulic and pneumatic lines, adhering to safety and
operational standards

Operational Maintenance and System Overhaul:

-  Perform maintenance and overhauls on mechanical and fluid power systems to ensure
consistent operational performance
-  Recommend preventative maintenance to optimize machinery longevity and efficiency
Advanced Troubleshooting:
-  Diagnose and resolve complex mechanical issues, providing process improvements for 
enhanced system functionality and efficiency

Skills and Qualifications Required:

Advanced Certification in Mechanical Fitting and Engineering:
-  Certificate III in Engineering - Mechanical Trade or equivalent qualification, with extensive 
experience in industrial mechanical fitting and system maintenance

Extensive Technical Expertise in Mechanical Systems:

-  Advanced knowledge of mechanical, hydraulic, and pneumatic systems, including the 
operation of specialized equipment such as CNC lathes

Leadership and Mentorship Abilities:

-  Demonstrated ability to mentor junior staff and provide leadership in complex maintenance 
tasks, fostering technical growth and team improvement


Salary range is $70,000 - $85,000pa commensurate with experience

Full-time Position available

Application opens on 21st of July 2026 and closes on 21st of August 2026.

result.description:
About Us
Simmonds Steel is a leading structural steel supplier and fabricator servicing residential, commercial, industrial and mining projects throughout Western Australia. We provide structural steel solutions ranging from small residential applications to large-scale commercial and industrial developments, including design support, 3D modelling, fabrication and installation services.
We are seeking an experienced and motivated Construction Estimator to join our team on a full-time basis.
Position Overview
Responsible for preparing accurate cost estimates and tender submissions for structural steel fabrication and installation projects. The role involves analysing engineering and architectural documentation, calculating material and labour requirements, obtaining supplier and subcontractor pricing, and supporting project delivery through effective cost planning and estimating. Involvement in tender settlement, cost planning, supplier negotiations, and project budget forecasting
Key Duties and Responsibilities
•	Review and interpret structural, architectural and engineering drawings, specifications and tender documentation.
•	Perform detailed quantity take-offs for structural steel components, including beams, columns, lintels, bracing systems, platework and associated materials.
•	Calculate project costs, including materials, fabrication, labour, transport, craneage, installation and subcontractor services.
•	Prepare accurate cost estimates, quotations, budgets and tender submissions for residential, commercial, industrial and mining projects.
•	Liaise with engineers, architects, project managers, clients and contractors to clarify project requirements and specifications.
•	Assess project risks, site conditions and construction methodologies affecting project costs and delivery.
•	Prepare and maintain estimating databases, cost records and pricing schedules.
•	Assist management in tender reviews, contract negotiations and project handovers.
•	Monitor market pricing trends for steel products, fabrication processes and construction services.
•	Support project planning by providing cost forecasts, material schedules and estimating reports.
•	Ensure all estimates comply with relevant Australian Standards, building codes, safety requirements and company procedures.
Skills and Experience
•	Diploma, Advanced Diploma or higher qualification in Building, Construction, Engineering or a related discipline.
•	Minimum 3 years’ relevant experience as a Construction Estimator, Steel Estimator, Building Estimator or similar role.
•	Strong ability to read and interpret structural and engineering drawings.
•	Experience estimating structural steel fabrication and installation projects.
•	Sound knowledge of construction methods, steel products and fabrication processes.
•	Proficiency with estimating software, Microsoft Excel and construction management systems.
•	Ability to manage multiple tenders and meet deadlines.
What We Offer
•	Full-time permanent position.
•	Competitive salary package of $90000.00 per annum plus superannuation
•	Supportive and professional working environment.
•	Career growth within an established structural steel business.
If you have the skills and experience to contribute to our growing team, we encourage you to apply.

In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, testing, and maintaining electrical systems and equipment, while ensuring adherence to industry standards, safety regulations, and quality requirements.   Benefits   Competitive salary package based on qualifications and experience.  Career growth and professional development opportunities.  Ongoing training and skill enhancement programs.  Supportive and collaborative work environment.  Health and wellness benefits (where applicable).  Paid annual leave and public holidays.  Performance recognition and reward programs. Task & responsibilities   Design, develop, and maintain electrical systems, equipment, and components.  Prepare electrical drawings, schematics, specifications, and technical documentation.  Conduct testing, inspections, troubleshooting, and fault-finding activities.  Ensure compliance with electrical codes, industry standards, and safety regulations.  Support installation, commissioning, and maintenance of electrical equipment.  Monitor project progress and provide technical guidance to project teams.  Analyze electrical system performance and recommend improvements.  Coordinate with clients, contractors, suppliers, and internal stakeholders.  Prepare project reports, cost estimates, and engineering calculations.  Participate in risk assessments and implement preventive measures to ensure workplace safety.  Assist in planning and executing electrical engineering projects within budget and schedule requirements.  Provide technical support and training to operational and maintenance teams as required.    Qualification & experience   Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering or a related engineering discipline.  At least 1 year of experience in electrical engineering, design, maintenance, testing, or project execution (or as required).  Strong knowledge of electrical systems, power distribution, control systems, and relevant engineering principles.  Experience with electrical drawings, schematics, and technical documentation.  Proficiency in engineering software such as AutoCAD, ETAP, MATLAB, or similar tools.  Familiarity with applicable electrical codes, standards, and safety regulations.  Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills.  Excellent communication and teamwork abilities.  Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet project deadlines.  Experience in industrial, commercial, manufacturing, construction, or infrastructure projects is an advantage.  Professional certifications or engineering registration/licensing (where required) will be highly regarded.  Valid driver's license and ability to travel to project sites if required. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in electrical engineering, with a experience in business development and commissioning within the building services sector.

 Provide technical expertise and guidance to project teams, including engineers, designers, and technicians.

 Collaborate with clients to understand their needs and develop customized solutions that meet or exceed expectations.

 Oversee commissioning activities to ensure the successful implementation and performance of electrical systems. 
 Stay current with industry trends, regulations, and emerging technologies to inform design decisions and maintain competitive advantage. 
 
  Qualifications:  
 
 Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or related field. 
 Professional Engineer (PE) license preferred.

 Experience in business development and client relationship management. 
 Strong technical proficiency in electrical design software and tools. 
 Experience with commissioning processes and procedures. 
 Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills. 
 Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team.

 Flexible working arrangements, including work-from-home options and early Friday finishes. 
 Clear progression pathways into Principal Engineer or Associate roles.

 Above-market remuneration, annual bonuses, and wellness perks
